items.title: Noetherian approximation of a finitely presented flat sheaf over a finitely presented morphism of affines
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a finitely presented morphism of affine schemes and a finitely presented sheaf flat over the base, the lemma produces a Noetherian approximation: a diagram as in the approximation setup lemma together with a sheaf F_0 over the Noetherian approximation that is flat over S_0. The proof is a written reduction into module algebra: it names the rings and module, verifies each of the three needed properties (B finitely presented over A, M finitely presented over B, M flat over A) with an explicit citation, and then applies the approximation lemma for flat modules over a limit ring. Retained author proof at lines 9799-9812.
